verdicts.reason: The delivery path (celeris delivery/auto_resolve.rs record_request) matches D4: it writes no notice, appends one IntegrationRequested event, the inbox shows only open requests as InboxKind::IntegrationRequest, and an answer appends IntegrationAnswered and removes the item. The phase-integration path does not match D4's one-to-one projection. In phase_integration.rs:555, record_integration_request is followed by integration_needs_human(&task, &integ, &request.to_markdown()). That calls integration_failure with force_human=true, which calls approvals::record_question_approval and adds QuestionRaised + Trigger::WorkerQuestion. So the same request shows up in the inbox a second time, as a question item whose body is the request markdown. human_inbox.rs has no code that hides one of the two. Answering the integration_request item only appends IntegrationAnswered: the question item stays, and the integrate WU stays blocked. Answering the question does not remove the integration_request item either. This breaks D4's 'one inbox item per request, removed when answered'. The tests do not catch it: the dispatcher test (auto_resolve_code_conflict_creates_integration_request_event) checks only open_integration_requests and notices, and never counts inbox items. Minor issues (not grounds for rejection on their own): (1) the D4 note says origin = phase:<integrate unit key>, but the code writes the fixed string 'phase:merge'. (2) The answers integrated/declined/retry only append an event; neither delivery nor the WU acts on them (e.g. retry does nothing). How to fix: in the phase path, either stop putting the request into the question (QuestionRaised/approval) or leave it out of the inbox, so it is shown only once as integration_request; make answering it the way the WU is resumed; and add a test checking that the phase path produces exactly one inbox item.
